```php
/**
 * When the first planet that is short of its next economy step can pay for it: a player checks
 * back when the upgrade they are saving for becomes payable. Without it an account whose planets
 * are a few minutes short waits for the routine gap with every build queue empty -- the state the
 * cohort reads as an idle economy whether or not the account is saving (ECON-001).
 */
private function affordabilityEta(AiProfile $profile, PerceptionSnapshot $perception, int $nowTimestamp): ?int
{
    $player = app(PlayerServiceFactory::class)->make($profile->player_id, true);
    $owned = $player->planets->all();
    $earliest = null;

    foreach ($perception->planets as $observed) {
        $planet = $owned[(int) ($observed['id'] ?? 0)] ?? null;
        if ($planet === null) continue;
        $eta = $this->planetAffordabilityEta($planet, $profile, $nowTimestamp);
        if ($eta !== null && ($earliest === null || $eta < $earliest)) $earliest = $eta;
    }

    return $earliest;
}
```

```php
private function planetAffordabilityEta(PlanetService $planet, AiProfile $profile, int $nowTimestamp): ?int
{
    $needed = $this->buildingPlanner->savingFor($planet, $profile);   // price + reserve, or null when not saving
    if ($needed === null) return null;

    $held = $planet->getResources();
    $hours = 0.0;
    foreach ([['metal', $planet->getMetalProductionPerHour()], ['crystal', ...], ['deuterium', ...]] as [$resource, $perHour]) {
        $short = $needed->{$resource}->get() - $held->{$resource}->get();
        if ($short <= 0.0) continue;
        if ($perHour <= 0.0) return null;    // never affordable by waiting: no income of that resource
        $hours = max($hours, $short / $perHour);
    }
    if ($hours <= 0.0) return null;          // payable now: the planner already offers it

    return $nowTimestamp + (int) ceil($hours * 3600.0);
}
```

/**
 * When the planet that is saving for its next economy step can pay for it: a player comes back
 * when the upgrade they are a few minutes short of becomes payable, instead of leaving every
 * build queue empty until the routine login (ECON-001's IDLE_QUEUES: at universe speeds a
 * planet earns the next step's price inside one routine gap, so a login that could not pay
 * leaves the queue idle until the next one). The price and the floor are the planner's own
 * answer, so nothing here restates an affordability rule or names an object.
 */
private function affordabilityEta(AiProfile $profile, PerceptionSnapshot $perception, int $nowTimestamp): ?int
{
    $player = app(PlayerServiceFactory::class)->make($profile->player_id, true);
    $earliest = null;

    foreach ($perception->planets as $observed) {
        $planet = $this->ownedPlanet($player, (int) ($observed['id'] ?? 0));
        if ($planet === null) {
            continue;
        }

        $planet->updateResources(false);
        $planet->updateResourceProductionStats(false);

        $eta = $this->planetAffordabilityEta($planet, $profile, $nowTimestamp);
        if ($eta !== null && ($earliest === null || $eta < $earliest)) {
            $earliest = $eta;
        }
    }

    return $earliest;
}
```

/** The moment this planet's next economy step becomes payable, or null when it is not saving or cannot earn it. */
private function planetAffordabilityEta(PlanetService $planet, AiProfile $profile, int $nowTimestamp): ?int
{
    $needed = $this->buildingPlanner->savingFor($planet, $profile);
    if ($needed === null) {
        return null;
    }

    $held = $planet->getResources();
    $hours = 0.0;

    foreach ([
        'metal' => [$needed->metal->get(), $held->metal->get(), $planet->getMetalProductionPerHour()],
        'crystal' => [$needed->crystal->get(), $held->crystal->get(), $planet->getCrystalProductionPerHour()],
        'deuterium' => [$needed->deuterium->get(), $held->deuterium->get(), $planet->getDeuteriumProductionPerHour()],
    ] as [$cost, $stored, $perHour]) {
        if ($cost <= $stored) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($perHour <= 0.0) {
            return null;   // a resource this planet cannot earn: waiting will not make the step payable
        }
        $hours = max($hours, ($cost - $stored) / $perHour);
    }

    return $hours <= 0.0 ? null : $nowTimestamp + (int) ceil($hours * 3600.0);
}
```
